assertions.name: 1_at_risk_set_has_not_grown
assertions.detail: 16 at risk vs baseline 40. Growth means a new witness landed asserting a pin its own producer cannot reproduce; the set should only drain.

assertions.name: 2_no_unlabelled_muon_q0value
assertions.detail: measured 0 witnesses carrying the muon q0Value with no q0Anchor — the label and the value are never separated in that direction, which is why keying on q0Value is the correct discriminator

description: Risk register: 49 witnesses assert q0Anchor 'muon' with the muon q0Value while their producer is absent from q0_anchor_manifest.json and would therefore resolve to the PROTON default on re-run — changing the substrate input ~11.5 ppb AND dropping the q0Anchor that would have shown it, in the same step. Nothing is wrong on disk today; each entry is a producer that cannot safely be re-run until its intended pin is declared.
computation_method: Reads q0_anchor_manifest.json for declared stems and the canonical muon pin from _q0_value_for_anchor('muon'), then scans every computations/**/*.witness.json for q0Anchor == 'muon' AND a q0Value matching the muon pin at 14 chars, with a scriptFile stem absent from the manifest. String comparison only; no float64.
q0AnchorReason: Reads no substrate value as an input. It compares recorded q0Value STRINGS against the canonical muon pin for classification only, and computes nothing from them, so no pin is used and none is recorded.
scope: scope-(a) RISK REGISTER, not a defect list. Nothing here is incorrect on disk; it enumerates producers whose next re-run would silently flip. Fixing means declaring each producer's intended pin in the manifest BEFORE re-running — re-running first destroys the evidence, since the committed muon q0Value is the only surviving record of intent for an unlisted producer.

result.measurement_correction: A first pass blob-searched the whole witness JSON for the muon 14-char prefix and reported 185. That over-counts by 3.8x — most hits are a muon value in a DATA field (a cross-anchor comparison, a recorded reference), which is not a pin claim. Key on q0Value. Do not quote the blob-search number.
